blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Presidential Task Force on Media Security (PTFOMS) on Monday vowed to pursue the arrest of dozens of accused who remain at large in the 2009 Maguindanao massacre, saying the victims’ families should not have to keep reminding the government that the case remains unfinished. In a statement marking the 17th anniversary of the massacre, PTFOMS Executive Director Jose Torres Jr. said the task force would continue coordinating with the Philippine National Police (PNP) and other agencies to serve outstanding arrest warrants against the remaining accused. “The families have carried this loss for seventeen years.
